description: DAO-ID: the same TableDef, Field, Index, Relation, QueryDef, Parameter, Property, Document, Workspace and Database are retrieved twice by name or ordinal while both references are live, the TableDef and Field once more through the second parent binding, and the TableDef again after the first reference is released. The worker records each returned object identity. Parameter-cell sharing: pId of the first QueryDef wrapper is set to 2, then Value is read through the same QueryDef's second Parameter and through the second QueryDef wrapper.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
